context:
Goal: a small fix to a review finding merges without a full review round it does not need.
Problem (rule): on PR #2892 a fix check failed on record wording only, and the rule sent it back to a new lane at round 1.
Based on (read): rule roles-review-cap-three, "A FAIL or a wider diff starts a new lane at round 1"; decision docs-only-prs-skip-review makes that round 1 check two things only.
Departs from: main starts a new lane at round 1 on any fix-check FAIL — b lets a second fix check carry when the diff is records and notes only.
home: rule roles-review-cap-three (review cap of three rounds)

lastAnswer.note: is it even a good idea to give purely wording edits the full round checks

options.gain: One rule, no variant to keep.
options.how: No change; a records-only round 1 already checks two things only.
options.label: Keep it: a FAIL starts round 1 (Recommended)
options.lose: A wording fix still takes a fresh round-1 review.

options.how: The rule and the merge tool accept a second fix check when the diff touches records and notes only. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: A second fix check carries for records only
options.lose: A rule variant the merge tool must read and someone keeps.

ref: runner 10 on #2892 (lane base-hash-on-base), via coordinator 14:07 CST Nov 12
reply: Closed 14:14 CST: a records-only FAIL gets a second fix check; rule roles-review-cap-three changes in a lane. Runner 10 and the coordinator told.
short: Wording FAIL: round 1 or 2nd fix check
title: A wording-only FAIL from a fix check: new round 1, or a second fix check
why: The rule says a FAIL starts round 1; only you change a rule.
